docs.title: 🏝️ Mokatoki Skyblock Wiki
docs.text:
Welcome to the Official Mokatoki Skyblock Guide! This wiki is your central resource for island progression, automation mechanics, character skills, pets, and a comprehensive player command reference.

⚖️ Strictly Free-To-Play (No Pay-To-Win)

Everything on Mokatoki Skyblock—including Minions, Pets, Talismans, Spawners, and Gear—can be earned 100% in-game through active gameplay, quests, skills, and the /shop.

Real-world store purchases are strictly limited to Cosmetics to support server hosting and development.

docs.title: 🚀 Beginner Quick-Start Guide
docs.text: If you're new to the server, follow these four simple steps to establish your skyblock empire:

docs.title: 1. Create Your Island
docs.text:
Start your adventure by creating a new island. 

/is create
Choose a starting schematic, and you'll be teleported to your new home.

docs.title: 2. Level Up & Earn Starting Funds
docs.text:
Open your skills menu and check your active quests to start earning money and unlocking stat boosts.

  • Run /skills to check your leveling progress.
  • Run /quests to view your main quests.

docs.title: 3. Automate Resource Collection
docs.text:
Save up your earnings to buy automation assistants.

  • Purchase a minion from the /minion store.
  • Place it on your island and link it to a nearby chest to automatically farm and store resources.

docs.title: 4. Climb the Leaderboard
docs.text:
Boost your island level to secure a spot at the top of the server.

  • Deposit money into the shared island bank via /is bank.
  • Place and stack valuable blocks (like Diamond, Gold, and Netherite) on your island.
  • Check the current rankings using /is top.

docs.title: ⚔️ Special Events
docs.text: Compete against the entire server in scheduled mini-games, competitions, and races! Server-wide events are scheduled challenges that reward the highest-performing players with exclusive loot, items, in-game currency, and cosmetic crate keys.

docs.title: 📜 Event Commands
docs.text:
Keep track of upcoming challenges and schedules:

  • Command: /events
  • Function: Opens a calendar/schedule GUI displaying active and upcoming events, timers, and reward brackets.

docs.title: ⚙️ How Events Work
docs.text: Events trigger automatically throughout the day, prompting players to participate in themed server-wide activities (such as fishing competitions, block mining rushes, or mob hunting contests).

docs.title: What You Can Win
docs.text:
Competing in these events allows you to earn valuable items to speed up your progression, including:

  • 🔑 Crate Keys: Used at spawn to unlock cosmetic and utility crates.
  • 🪙 In-Game Currency: Direct boosts to your wallet balance.
  • 📦 Unique Resources: Exclusive tools, custom weapons, advanced spawners, and boosters.

docs.title: 🤖 Minions System
docs.text: Automate your island's resource generation and processing using Minions! These helper NPCs perform automated tasks, allowing you to generate income and materials even while busy building.

docs.title: 📜 Minion Commands
docs.text:
Use the following commands to manage and buy minions:

Command Alternative Description /minion /minions Opens the main Minion management GUI dashboard. /minion store - Opens the in-game Minion Store to purchase new minions using in-game currency.

docs.title: 🛠️ Minion Types
docs.text:
There are five specialized types of minions available to automate your island:

  • ⛏️ Miner
    • Automatically mines ore and stone generators placed in front of it.
  • ⚔️ Slayer
    • Automatically kills mobs that spawn or are channeled in front of it.
  • 🪓 Lumberjack
    • Automatically cuts down trees and logs within its working radius.
  • 🧑‍🌾 Farmer
    • Automatically plants, grows, and harvests crops in its farming field.
  • 🎣 Fisher
    • Automatically fishes in a designated adjacent water source.

docs.title: 📦 Inventory & Chest Linking
docs.text:
Minions do not have an internal inventory. To collect and save the resources they generate, you must link them to an external chest:

  • Requirement: Place a chest within 30 blocks of the minion.
  • Mechanism: Open the minion's GUI, select the chest-link tool, and click on the chest you want to link.
  • Important: If no chest is linked, all items harvested or collected by the minion will drop directly onto the ground.

docs.title: 🍖 Feeding & Health
docs.text:
Minions start with 0 Health when placed and must be fed before they can begin working.

  • Energy depletion: Minions consume energy and lose health as they work. If their health drops to 0, they will stop working.
  • Healing via Food: Right-click the minion while holding food items (such as Bread, Apples, Steak, or Golden Apples) to restore their health.
  • Healing via GUI: Open the minion's GUI and pay a small fee in in-game currency to heal them instantly.

docs.title: 🎒 Placing & Picking Up
docs.text:
• Placing: Place the minion item down on a block like any other placeable object.
  • Pickup: Simply Left-click the minion to return it to your inventory as an item. Any linked chest configuration is preserved when placing it back down.

docs.title: 🏪 Economy, Trades & Auctions
docs.text: Mokatoki Skyblock runs on a robust virtual economy. Acquire wealth, buy resources from the official shop, list your items on the Global Auction House, or trade securely with other players.

docs.title: 📜 Economy Commands
docs.text:
Manage your wallet and perform basic money transfers:

Command Alternative Description /balance /bal Displays your current wallet balance. /pay <player> <amount> - Safely sends money directly to another online player's wallet. /shop - Opens the main GUI server shop to buy/sell blocks, minerals, crops, spawners, and farm essentials.

docs.title: 🛍️ Auction House (/ah)
docs.text:
The Auction House allows players to sell items globally to the highest bidder or as a direct buy-it-now listing.

  • /ah - Opens the global marketplace interface where you can browse and purchase items listed by other players.
  • /ah sell <price> - Lists the item currently in your main hand for sale at the specified price.

docs.title: 🤝 Player Trading (/trade)
docs.text:
To prevent scams and ensure safe item-for-item or item-for-money transfers, always use the secure trading system:

  • Command: /trade <player>
  • Mechanism: Sends an interactive trade invitation to another online player. Once accepted, a split-screen inventory menu will open where both players can safely offer items and money. Both parties must click the confirmation lock to complete the trade.

docs.title: 🐾 Pets System
docs.text: Unlock loyal companions that follow you around, show off custom cosmetic particles, and grant significant gameplay buffs. Pets are dynamic entities that grow stronger as you train.

docs.title: 📜 Pet Commands
docs.text: Command Alternative Description /pets /pet Opens your Pet collection GUI to summon, dismiss, or manage pets. /pet menu - Accesses the configuration menu for pet leveling, details, and active skills.

docs.title: ⚙️ How Pets Work
docs.text: Pets act as passive stat multipliers and companions. Summon a pet from your collection menu, and it will float alongside you.

docs.title: 📈 Leveling Your Pet
docs.text:
Your pets gain experience points (XP) as you perform activities corresponding to their specialty:

  • ⛏️ Mining Pets — Train them by mining stone, ores, or custom cobble generators.
  • 🧑‍🌾 Farming Pets — Train them by planting seeds and harvesting mature crops.
  • ⚔️ Combat Pets — Train them by fighting monsters and hostile entities.

As your pet levels up, its passive buffs scale dynamically, becoming significantly more powerful.

docs.title: ⚔️ Passive Multipliers & Buffs
docs.text:
Summoning a pet activates specific passive multipliers:

  • 📈 Extra XP Gains — Earn bonus experience points toward your skills and jobs.
  • 🌾 Double Crop Harvests — Increase your crop yield multipliers automatically while farming.
  • 💥 Bonus Damage — Deal extra combat damage to clear mob grinding spawners faster.

docs.title: 🧿 Talismans
docs.text: Equip passive artifacts that grant unique power boosts, combat stats, and utility modifications. Talismans are essential tools for optimizing your character's combat, speed, and farming efficiency.

docs.title: 📜 Talisman Commands
docs.text: Command Alternative Description /talismans bag /talisman bag Opens your active Talisman Bag.

docs.title: ⚙️ How Talismans Work
docs.text:
To gain the benefits of a talisman, you must carry it in either your character's main inventory or, preferably, inside your dedicated Talisman Bag:

  • Talisman Bag: Open this bag via /talismans bag. Storing your talismans here keeps them active without cluttering your inventory slots!
  • Unique Effects: Each talisman provides a unique perk. Examples of passive buffs include:
    • ⚡ Speed: Increases your base walking/sprinting speed.
    • 👁️ Night Vision: Grants permanent night vision.
    • 🛡️ Resistance: Provides permanent damage mitigation.
    • 💥 Critical Hit Chance: Increases your chance to deal critical hits in combat.
    • 💰 Increased Loot: Boosts the amount of mob drops or money earned.

Duplicate Talismans

Having duplicate talismans of the same type in your bag or inventory does not stack their effects. Only the highest-tier version of a duplicate talisman will apply!

docs.title: 🏝️ Island Commands & Setup
docs.text: Managing your island revolves around the primary /is command interface. Below is a comprehensive reference guide for all commands, grouped by function.

docs.title: 🏝️ Core Island Commands
docs.text:
These commands allow you to create, navigate, and manage the general properties of your island.

Command Alternative Description /is /is menu Opens your main Skyblock control GUI. /is create - Creates a brand-new Skyblock island. /is home /is tp Teleports you safely back to your island spawn point. /is setteleport - Sets a custom spawn/teleport location for your island. /is level - Recalculates and displays your island's current Level and Worth. /is settings - Opens settings to toggle PvP, mob spawning, and visitor permissions. /is border - Customizes or toggles your personal island world border.

docs.title: 🏦 Island Bank & Upgrades
docs.text:
Pool your resources with team members to fund upgrades and expand your island's limits.

Command Description /is bank Deposit or withdraw money from your shared island bank to fund island growth. /is upgrade Opens the upgrade menu! Spend money to increase crop growth speeds, spawner spawn rates, hopper limits, max team members, and border size.

docs.title: 👥 Team & Visitor Commands
docs.text:
Control who can access, build, or visit your island. Use coop commands to collaborate temporarily.

Command Description /is invite <player> Invites a player to join your island team. /is kick <player> Removes a member from your island team. /is leave Leave your current island team. /is coop <player> Temporarily grants building/access rights to a visitor. /is uncoop <player> Revokes temporary coop permissions from a visitor. /is ban <player> Bans a troublesome player from visiting your island. /is unban <player> Unbans a player from visiting your island.

docs.title: 🌐 Warps & Leaderboards
docs.text:
Discover other players' creations or share your own with the community.

Command Description /is top Opens the island leaderboard sorted by total Worth & Level. /is warp <player> Teleports to another player's public Welcome/Warp sign. /is setwarp <name> Sets up a public warp point for visitors on your island. /is delwarp <name> Removes a public warp point from your island.

docs.title: 📈 Island Level & Worth System
docs.text: Your position on the server-wide /is top leaderboard is determined by the total Worth and Level of your island. This rating is calculated dynamically based on the blocks placed within your island boundaries.

docs.title: 💎 Valuable Blocks
docs.text:
Placing blocks of precious metals and gems is the primary way to raise your island level. The higher the tier of the block, the more worth points it contributes.

The following blocks increase your island value: * 🪙 Iron Blocks — Entry-level progression blocks. * 🪙 Gold Blocks — Moderate-tier progression blocks. * 💎 Diamond Blocks — High-tier progression blocks. * 💚 Emerald Blocks — Advanced progression blocks. * 🌌 Netherite Blocks — Premium/highest-tier progression blocks.

docs.title: 📦 Stacked Blocks
docs.text:
As your island grows, placing individual blocks can take up valuable building space. To solve this, you can stack valuable blocks in a single block space.

  • Command: /is toggle blocks
  • How it works: Toggling this setting allows you to stack blocks of the same type directly on top of each other. This consolidates their worth and saves physical space, allowing you to maximize your island score without filling your entire island with block grids.

docs.title: 📜 Quests & Jobs
docs.text: Supplement your island's economy by taking up jobs and completing quests. Doing so awards in-game money, keys, and special materials!

docs.title: 📜 Quests
docs.text:
Quests provide objectives that you can complete during gameplay:

  • Command: /quests or /q
  • Main Quests: Long-term milestones representing your overarching progress on the server.

docs.title: 💼 Jobs
docs.text: Jobs reward you with passive cash and experience as you perform actions like mining, farming, and hunting.

docs.title: Job Commands
docs.text:
• /jobs - Opens the main Jobs GUI to browse, join, or leave jobs.
  • /jobs stats - Checks your active job levels, current experience, and total daily earnings.

docs.title: Available Jobs
docs.text:
You can join the following professions to match your island activities:

Job Action Rewarded Description / Ideal For Blacksmith Repairing and upgrading gear / items Tool upkeep and weapon forging Brewer Brewing potions and custom elixirs Potion brewers and alchemists Builder Placing blocks and constructing structures Building island expansions Crafter Crafting items and materials General crafting and production Digger Excavating dirt, sand, gravel, and clay Terraforming and block clearing Explorer Traveling and discovering zones Exploring and map traversal Farmer Harvesting crops and planting seeds Large-scale agricultural farms Fisher Catching fish and treasure from water Custom fishing ponds Hunter Defeating hostile mobs and animals Mob grinding arenas Lumberjack Chopping down trees and clearing logs Tree farms and woodcutting Miner Mining stone, cobble, and various ores Cobble and ore generators Shepheard Shearing sheep and breeding animals Livestock farming and shearing

docs.title: 🌟 Skills System
docs.text: Level up your character natively by performing standard in-game actions! The skills system adds RPG-style character development that rewards your dedication with permanent stat upgrades and special abilities.

docs.title: 📜 Skill Commands
docs.text: Command Alternative Description /skills /sk Opens the main Skills menu displaying levels, XP progress, and active stat bonuses. /skills top - Opens leaderboards showing the top players for each skill.

docs.title: 📊 Character Stats
docs.text:
As you level up your skills, you will receive permanent bonuses to your core statistics:

  • ❤️ Health: Increases your maximum health pool.
  • 💪 Strength: Boosts your physical damage output.
  • 🛡️ Defense: Reduces incoming damage from mobs and players.
  • 🍀 Luck: Increases the chance of double or rare drops from farming and mining.

docs.title: ⚙️ How Skills Work
docs.text:
You earn experience (XP) in each skill by performing relevant tasks. Here are the core skills:

Skill How to Train Main Benefits Mining Mine stone, ores, and generators High double-drop chances, defense bonuses Farming Harvest crops and replant Double crop rates, health bonuses Combat Defeat hostile mobs and entities Damage multipliers, strength bonuses Foraging Chop down trees and clear logs Double log drops, strength/health Fishing Catch fish and treasure in water Rare loot tables, luck bonuses Alchemy Brew custom and vanilla potions Extended potion duration Enchanting Use enchantment tables and books XP multipliers, luck bonuses Archery Shoot targets and mobs with bows Ranged damage multipliers Defense Take damage from mobs and players Permanent damage reduction Excavation Dig dirt, sand, gravel, and clay Treasure drops, luck bonuses Agility Run, sprint, and jump Speed boosts, fall damage reduction

Perks and Abilities

Each skill also contains active abilities (triggered by right-clicking with the skill's tool and hitting a block/mob) and passive perks that unlock at milestone levels. Keep leveling to unlock their full potential!

docs.title: 💄 Cosmetics
docs.text: Personalize your appearance and stand out in the chat and spawn! Our cosmetic items are 100% visual and do not grant any unfair gameplay advantages, aligning with our fair-play values.

docs.title: 📜 Cosmetic Commands
docs.text:
Manage your active cosmetics with these commands:

Command Alternative Description /cosmetics /uc Opens the main Cosmetics Selection GUI. /cosmetics clear - Instantly disables all currently active cosmetic effects on your character.

docs.title: 🎭 Cosmetic Types
docs.text:
You can unlock and equip a variety of cosmetic modifiers:

  • ✨ Particle Trails: Beautiful particle patterns (e.g. hearts, flame trails, notes) that follow you as you walk, jump, and fly.
  • 👒 Hats: Custom hats and blocks displayed on your head.
  • 👔 Suits: Colorful armor combinations that trigger unique animations when a full set is equipped.
  • 💬 Emotes: Quick visual chat expressions and reactions.
  • 🐕 Cosmetic Pets: Mini-companions that accompany you for display only (note: these do not offer the leveling stat multipliers of Pets).

docs.title: 👥 Friends & Social System
docs.text: Stay connected with your friends and teammates using our built-in social system. Build your list and see who is online.

docs.title: 📜 Friend Commands
docs.text:
All friendship features can be accessed using the /friend or /f prefix:

Command Alternative Description /friend /f Opens your Friends list GUI dashboard. /f add <player> - Sends a friend request to an online player. /f remove <player> - Removes a player from your friends list. /f list - Displays a list of your friends and their online status in chat.
